ui.hero1: Buy and sell crypto, person to person
ui.hero2: Zero taker fees. Escrow on every trade. 70+ payment methods in 150+ currencies.
ui.how1d: Pick an offer and enter the amount. The seller's crypto is locked in escrow instantly.
ui.how2d: Send the payment with the reference code using the seller's payment method.
ui.how3d: The seller confirms and escrow releases the crypto to your wallet.
ui.why1d: Crypto stays locked until both sides are done. Nobody can walk away with your funds.
ui.why2d: Identity checks, reputation scores and payer-name matching on every trade.
ui.why3d: Human arbiters step in within minutes if something goes wrong.
ui.why4d: 2FA, passkeys, withdrawal allowlists and device alerts come standard.
ui.methodsTitle: Pay the way you already do
ui.depositNote: Send only {asset} on {network} to this address. Deposits are credited after network confirmations.
ui.withdrawNote: New addresses become usable 24 hours after you add them.
ui.merchantDesc: Lower fees, a verified badge and API access for high-volume traders.
ui.chatSafety: Keep payment and chat on the platform. Never share passwords or codes.
ui.waitSeller: Waiting for the seller to release
ui.payWithin: Pay the seller within the time limit
ui.waitBuyer: Waiting for the buyer to pay
ui.sellerWaiting: The buyer is paying now. Your crypto is safely locked in escrow.
ui.buyerWaiting: Payment marked as sent. The seller will release the crypto once they see your money.
ui.tip1: Only pay from an account in your own name.
ui.tip2: Never release crypto before the money is in your account.
ui.tip3: Our team will never ask you to trade outside the platform.
ui.disputeHint: An arbiter will review the chat, payment proof and order history. Upload clear evidence.
ui.testMode: Test mode: no real money moves. Top up with test funds to try trading.
ui.pmHint: Add the accounts you get paid into. Buyers only see them during an active order.
ui.label: Label
ui.transferHint: Send crypto instantly and for free to another user on the platform.
ui.level3d: Source of funds for high limits
ui.twoFaDesc: Required to release crypto, withdraw and change security settings.
ui.phoneDesc: Get SMS alerts and recover your account.
ui.noAds: You have no ads yet. Post one to start receiving orders.
ui.authSub: Join traders in 150+ countries. Escrow on every order, zero taker fees.
ui.corridorSub: Send money between currencies in one tap. We route through USDT and two escrowed trades, so you get close to the market rate.
ui.heroSub: Buy and sell securely with people around the world on {brand}: fast, fair and protected by escrow.
ui.indicativeNote: Estimated at the best current P2P offer prices
ui.partialValuation: some assets have no offers in this currency
ui.rewardsDesc: We're building a rewards program for traders and the friends they invite. It isn't live yet, so there are no rewards to claim today.
ui.disputeHelp: Open a dispute from the order page if payment or release goes wrong.
ui.statusHelp: Live health of trading, deposits and withdrawals.
ui.helpSub: Answers, safety tips and how to reach us.
ui.agree: By creating an account you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.
ui.authHero: Trade with people. Protected by escrow.
ui.buyerSendsHint: To your account, with the trade reference
ui.cancelledHint: This trade was cancelled. Nothing left escrow.
ui.confirmHint: Only after the money is in your account
ui.confirmOnlyAfter: Confirm only after the money arrives
ui.escrowNote: Every trade is protected by escrow. The crypto is locked before you pay.
ui.frozenNotLost: Your funds are frozen, not lost.
ui.fundsFrozen: Funds frozen until an arbiter decides
ui.name: Name
ui.openBankingApp: Open your banking app and check that the full amount arrived from the buyer's own account.
ui.payOwnName: Pay only from an account in your own name. Never mention crypto in the transfer note.
ui.rDifferentAccount: Seller asked me to pay a different account
ui.rPaidNotReleased: I paid but the seller didn't release
ui.underTwoMin: Less than two minutes left. Pay now or the order is cancelled.
ui.youPaid: You've paid, the seller is checking
ui.youSendHint: By bank transfer, with the reference
ui.sellerChecksHint: They check their bank, then release
ui.blockedNote: You blocked this trader. You won't see each other's offers or trade together.
ui.alertBuyHint: We'll notify you when someone sells {asset} at or below this price.
ui.alertSellHint: We'll notify you when someone buys {asset} at or above this price.
ui.alertCreated: Alert created. You'll get a notification when it's reached.
ui.priceAlertsDesc: Create them from the Trade page with the bell button.
ui.autoReplyHint: Sent in the trade chat as soon as an order starts. No phone numbers, links or outside contacts.
ui.awayDesc: Hide all your ads while you're away. Open orders are not affected.
ui.awayOn: You're on a break: your ads are hidden from the market.
ui.nicknameDesc: Shown to other traders. 3–20 letters, numbers, spaces, _ or -.
ui.antiPhishingDesc: A word only you know. We include it in every email so you can spot fakes.
ui.antiPhishingSet: Set: {code}. Every email from us shows it.
ui.followedDesc: Filter the market to their offers with “Traders I follow”.
ui.blockedDesc: You won't see their offers and they can't trade with you. Open a trader's passport to unblock.
ui.referralHow: Share your link. Friends who sign up with it are linked to your account, and you can see how many joined and traded.
ui.referralRewardsSoon: Invite rewards are not live yet. Friends you invite now are already counted.
ui.otcTeaser: Trading a large amount? Request a quote.
ui.otcDesc: Trading a large amount? Tell us what you need and our desk will contact you by email to arrange it.
ui.otcSent: Request sent. Our desk will contact you by email.
ui.businessHoursDesc: Your ads show only during these hours. Time zone: {tz}.
ui.hoursOffNow: Outside your business hours now: your ads are hidden until you open.
ui.safeIntro: Check these before you confirm. They prevent most P2P scams and frozen payments.
ui.safe1: I'm paying from an account in my own name.
ui.safe2: I'm sending exactly {amount} to {holder}, the name shown on this order.
ui.safe3: My payment note has only the order reference: no words like crypto, USDT or P2P.
ui.safe4: Nobody asked me to pay outside parley or to a different account.
ui.rewardRule: You get {amount} {asset} when a friend you invited completes their first trade of ${min} or more with someone other than you.
ui.signalsTitle: Take extra care with this buyer
ui.signal_new_account: Account created less than 7 days ago
ui.signal_large_for_history: Large amount for so few past trades
ui.signal_high_risk: Our risk checks rated this order high
ui.receiptNote: Automatic checks only catch some fakes. Always confirm the money is in your account before you release.
ui.receiptNoteAi: Amounts and names are read automatically and can be wrong. Always confirm the money is in your account before you release.
ui.rflag_duplicate_receipt: The same file was already used on another order
ui.rflag_edited: The image was saved by an editing app ({tool})
ui.rflag_older_than_order: The image was taken before this order existed
ui.rflag_amount_mismatch: The amount on the receipt differs from the order
ui.rflag_payee_mismatch: The receiver on the receipt isn't your payment name
ui.rflag_payer_mismatch: The payer on the receipt isn't the buyer's verified name
ui.scam_release_first: Caution: asking you to release before payment is a common scam
ui.scam_payment_pending: Caution: "payment pending" is not money received. Release only when it's in your account
ui.scam_other_account: Caution: refunds or payments to "another account" are a common scam
ui.scam_third_party: Caution: payments from someone else's account are not allowed and often lead to frozen funds
ui.scam_fake_fee: Caution: parley never asks for fees to release or unlock a trade
ui.scam_chargeback: Caution: this looks like a payment-reversal trick. Keep everything in this chat
ui.promoteDesc: Your ad appears in the Promoted spots above the offer list for its market, labelled "Promoted". It only shows to people whose filters match it.
ui.promotedUntil: Promoted until {date}. Adding days extends it.
ui.shopLinkDesc: Share it on social media: buyers see only your offers and can trade in one tap.
ui.shopLinkNick: Set a nickname in Account for a shorter link.
ui.shopClosed: This trader isn't taking orders right now.
ui.chartEmpty: Price history appears here after a few minutes of trading.
ui.guide1: Type how much you want to pay and pick an offer.
ui.guide2: The seller's crypto is locked in escrow right away.
ui.guide3: Send the money from your own account, then tap "I have paid".
ui.guide4: The seller confirms and the crypto lands in your wallet. Problem? Open an appeal and an arbiter decides.
